books.title: Berthe ou Le Devoir accompli — Pierre Dartois — Mégard, 1893
books.description:
A work of moral literature for young readers, in a red decorated board binding with flowers, birds and black-and-gold architectural motifs.

Language of this copy: French. This English page describes the French-language book offered.

Author: Pierre Dartois
Edition: Rouen, Mégard et Cie, 1893. Bibliothèque morale de la jeunesse series; engravings in the text. The year is legible on the photographed title page.

Appearance and condition: Visible wear to the corners and the foot of the binding.

The photographs show the copy offered. Completeness and the soundness of the gatherings cannot be certified from the photographs alone; they remain to be checked on the physical book.

Asking price: EUR 12, excluding delivery.
books.metaDescription: Berthe ou Le Devoir accompli by Pierre Dartois, Mégard, 1893. French-language copy, decorated red binding, visible wear. EUR 12 excluding delivery.

books.title: Le Merveilleux Voyage de Nils Holgersson — Selma Lagerlöf — Delagrave, 1949
books.description:
Nils's journey through Sweden, in T. Hammar's French translation, illustrated by Roger Reboussin. Burgundy half binding, ochre marbled boards and gilt title.

Language of this copy: French. This English page describes the French-language book offered.

Author: Selma Lagerlöf
Edition: Paris, Librairie Delagrave, 15 rue Soufflot, 1949. The year is legible on the title page. The printing statement mentions several special-paper issues, but no individual copy number is visible for this volume: this copy is not claimed to be one of those special-paper issues.

Appearance and condition: Yellowed leaves and edges; the condition of the binding is shown in the gallery.

The photographs show the copy offered. Completeness and the soundness of the gatherings cannot be certified from the photographs alone; they remain to be checked on the physical book.

Asking price: EUR 35, excluding delivery.
books.metaDescription: Le Merveilleux Voyage de Nils Holgersson, Delagrave, 1949. French translation, Roger Reboussin illustrations. EUR 35 excluding delivery.

books.title: Quentin Durward — Walter Scott — Armand Colin, 1934 — Prix municipal
books.description:
Walter Scott's historical novel in a red decorated board binding bearing the arms of the City of Paris and the gilt words Prix municipal.

Language of this copy: French. This English page describes the French-language book offered.

Author: Walter Scott
Edition: Paris, Librairie Armand Colin, 1934. Adapted by M. Guéchot from Defauconpret's translation; illustrated by Albert Robida. The edition number remains to be confirmed. The school-prize label is dated 1937: this award date is distinct from the publication year.

Appearance and condition: Yellowed edges; the condition of the binding, spine and label is shown in the gallery.

The photographs show the copy offered. Completeness and the soundness of the gatherings cannot be certified from the photographs alone; they remain to be checked on the physical book.

Asking price: EUR 20, excluding delivery.
